contents: the weights of the causal temporal convolutional network (22465 weights), the per-channel input mean and standard deviation, and the class prior
model_kind: causal dilated temporal convolutional network on band-level features, 93.75 frames per second; outputs the probabilities of the classes beat, off-beat and none
runtime_decision: Compiled into the DSP module and evaluated once per analysis frame with fixed weights; Nothing is trained or adapted at run time.

training_parameters.sampling: no per-source weights: tracks are drawn in proportion to their frames

selection: Slakh2100-redux validation split and Groove MIDI validation fold were used for early stopping and to choose the checkpoint (best validation cross-entropy 0.1514); the network was not trained on them.
training_exclusion: The Winterreise HU33 recordings were not used for training or fitting this artifact.
